mapper.sql: id, component_key, display_name, description, model_profile_id, system_prompt, model_options, budget_json, published_version, publication_generation, enabled, revision, created_by, created_at, updated_at
r.id, r.agent_id, c.component_key, r.version, r.manifest_json, r.manifest_digest, r.state, r.generation, r.release_cursor, r.created_at
mapper.select: select from ai_agent_component order by component_key
select from ai_agent_component where id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_component ( id, component_key, display_name, description, model_profile_id, system_prompt, model_options, budget_json, enabled, revision, created_by) values ( #{id}, #{key}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{modelProfileId}, #{systemPrompt}, cast(#{modelOptionsJson} as jsonb), cast(#{budgetJson} as jsonb), true, 0, #{actor})
mapper.update: update ai_agent_component set display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, model_profile_id = #{modelProfileId}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, model_options = cast(#{modelOptionsJson} as jsonb), budget_json = cast(#{budgetJson} as jsonb), enabled = #{enabled}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: select b.mcp_release_id, c.component_key, r.version, b.tool_name, b.required, b.execution_order, null::text as descriptor from ai_agent_mcp_binding b join ai_mcp_release r on r.id = b.mcp_release_id join ai_mcp_component c on c.id = r.component_id where b.agent_id = #{agentId} order by b.execution_order, c.component_key, b.tool_name

select b.skill_release_id, c.component_key, r.version, b.order_no, b.load_mode, r.bundle_digest, r.name, r.description from ai_agent_skill_binding b join ai_skill_release r on r.id = b.skill_release_id join ai_skill_component c on c.id = r.skill_id where b.agent_id = #{agentId} order by b.order_no, c.component_key
mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_mcp_binding ( agent_id, mcp_release_id, tool_name, required, execution_order) values ( #{agentId}, #{mcpReleaseId}, #{toolName}, #{required}, #{executionOrder})
insert into ai_agent_skill_binding (agent_id, skill_release_id, order_no, load_mode) values (#{agentId}, #{skillReleaseId}, #{orderNo}, #{loadMode})

insert into ai_agent_release ( id, agent_id, version, manifest_json, manifest_digest, state, generation, created_by) values ( #{id}, #{agentId}, #{version}, cast(#{manifestJson} as jsonb), #{manifestDigest}, 'STAGED', #{generation}, #{actor})
mapper.select: select from ai_agent_release r join ai_agent_component c on c.id = r.agent_id where r.id = #{id}
select from ai_agent_release r join ai_agent_component c on c.id = r.agent_id where r.agent_id = #{agentId} and r.state = 'ACTIVE' order by r.created_at desc limit 1
select from ai_agent_release r join ai_agent_component c on c.id = r.agent_id where r.agent_id = #{agentId} order by r.created_at desc
select from ai_agent_release r join ai_agent_component c on c.id = r.agent_id where r.state = 'ACTIVE' and c.enabled = true order by c.component_key
select from ai_agent_release r join ai_agent_component c on c.id = r.agent_id where c.enabled = true and r.state = 'ACTIVE' and c.published_version = r.version order by r.release_cursor

select from ai_agent_release r join ai_agent_component c on c.id = r.agent_id where c.enabled = true and r.state = 'ACTIVE' and ( c.published_version = r.version or r.id in ( select agent_release_id from ai_conversation where agent_release_id is not null union all select agent_release_id from ai_run where agent_release_id is not null and status in ('QUEUED', 'DISPATCHING', 'RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') ) ) order by r.release_cursor
select from ai_agent_release r join ai_agent_component c on c.id = r.agent_id where c.component_key = #{agentKey} and c.enabled = true and c.published_version = r.version and r.state = 'ACTIVE'
select coalesce(max(generation), 0) + 1 from ai_agent_release where agent_id = #{agentId}
select count(*) from ai_agent_release where agent_id = #{agentId}
select count(*) from ai_conversation c where c.agent_release_id in (select id from ai_agent_release where agent_id = #{agentId})
mapper.update: update ai_agent_component c set published_version = #{version}, publication_generation = #{expectedGeneration}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() where c.id = #{agentId} and ( publication_generation < #{expectedGeneration} or (publication_generation = #{expectedGeneration} and published_version = #{version}) ) and exists ( select 1 from ai_agent_release r where r.agent_id = c.id and r.version = #{version} and r.state = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: select published_version from ai_agent_component where component_key = #{agentKey} and enabled = true
